messages:
sam: Noticing intermittent 502s hitting embeddings in eu-west1 from edge-auth. Patch built: v2.3.15. Need expedited signoff to shorten canary and pin the image.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] action requested: release edge-auth:v2.3.15. Default canary 15m, approvals required to shorten.

lee: Severity=high for low-latency customers. Recommend 10% canary for 3m, then fast ramp if stable.

anika: I can approve infra if QA confirms smoke results within canary. @qa-lead can you run quick smoke?

qa-lead: Running smoke now against canary endpoints. Tests: basic auth handshake, stream keepalive, embedding path. ETA ~2m.

sam: Rollback rules: revert if 502 rate >0.3% absolute or p50 latency regresses >30% for 2 consecutive minutes. Also manual rollback allowed.

lee: I approve expedited canary (infra). Adding autoscaler policies and log hooks.

ops-oncall: Ops signoff. We'll monitor and have runbook ready. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [deploybot] approvals: 2/2. Waiting on QA smoke green to start canary.

qa-lead: Smoke green. No 502s in the quick suite and KV warmup looks normal. Marking green.

sam: Deploy command for lead:
```
/deploy edge-auth --image=registry.redwood/edge-auth:v2.3.15 --region=eu-west1 --canary=10% --canary-duration=3m --pin=true --fast-ramp=true
```

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary starting: 3 replicas, 10% traffic.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary 1m: 502s down 70% vs baseline, request latency stable.

anika: Observability: traces look clean. KV hit-rate normal. Not seeing request header regressions.

ops-oncall: No anomalies. Ready for ramp at end of canary.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary complete (3m). Metrics within thresholds. Initiating 90s cutover to 100%.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] cutover 30s: small blip but error rate within rollback bounds. Continuing.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] deployment complete. edge-auth@v2.3.15 is now serving in eu-west1. Release note: "Hotfix: fix transient race in stream handling causing occasional 502s; improves early KV warm behavior."

san: (typo) sam: Thanks all. Will add to changelog and follow up with post-deploy perf capture.

anika: Follow-up: schedule CI test for the race and add a canary default override for edge services.

ops-oncall: ACK, closing thread.
